tree-1.story: A resident asked Forestry to inspect a city tree on the 1200 block of HEBERT ST (Ward 14) on 19 March 2025; the inspection was logged done on 10 April, a Forestry removal work order at the same address shows a projected start of 12:26 PM that day, and the 311 request was cancelled a minute later with no words; the public record says "cancelled", the work order says removal by 14 November 2025, and it was still open on 13 October 2026.

tree-2.story: On 12 June 2026 a resident asked Forestry to inspect a city tree on the 6700 block of DALE AVE (Ward 4); Forestry already had an open removal work order there, started 575 days earlier and due by 20 June 2025; the request was cancelled 2 hours later with no public words, so the public record never says the tree was already on the removal list (3 inspection requests at that address since the work order started), and the work order was still open on 13 October 2026.
